Sinja Kraus (born 29 April 2002) is an Austrian tennis player.
She has career-high WTA rankings of world No. 100 in singles and No. 238 in doubles, achieved in January 2026. Kraus has won one WTA 125 singles title as well as 13 singles and two doubles titles on the ITF Circuit . Juniors [ edit ] She reached a career-high ITF juniors ranking of world No. 87, on 21 January 2019. [ citation needed ] Kraus also won a bronze medal at the 2017 European Youth Summer Olympic Festival in Győr . [ 1 ] National representation [ edit ] She represents Austria in the Billie Jean King Cup and made her debut in 2020 , when she partnered Melanie Klaffner in the (then Fed Cup ) tie against Italy , losing to Giulia Gatto-Monticone and Martina Trevisan . [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Career [ edit ] Kraus made her WTA Tour main-draw debut as a wildcard entrant at the 2021 Linz Open , losing to Alison Van Uytvanck in the first round. [ 4 ] As a qualifier, she defeated eighth seed Nadia Podoroska to reach the second round at the WTA 125 2023 Bogota Open , [ 5 ] where she lost to Nuria Brancaccio . [ 6 ] Kraus won her first WTA 125 title at the 2025 Cali Open , defeating Panna Udvardy in the final. [ 7 ] Grand Slam performance timeline [ edit ] Key W F SF QF #R RR Q# DN
